resources.string: Start a session to block YouTube\'s distractions. You can still learn from educational videos in FocusTube.
Make sure focus lasts at least %1$s
While focus is on, you can\'t end the session early or loosen your filters.
Strict mode is on. You can end the session or turn strict mode off when focus time is over.
Strict mode is on. You can add blocked words, but other changes wait until focus time is over.
Strict mode is on. You can trust new channels after focus time.
Without it, FocusTube can\'t stop the YouTube app or youtube.com from opening during focus time.

FocusTube uses Android's Accessibility service to see when the YouTube app, or youtube.com in a web browser, comes on screen during focus time, and then shows a "Stay focused" screen instead.

It only looks at YouTube apps and web browsers, only checks the app name and the address bar, and never stores or shares anything it sees.

On the next screen, tap "FocusTube" and switch it on.
Blocks the YouTube app and youtube.com during your focus time so you can stay on track. FocusTube only checks which app is open and the address of the web page. Nothing is stored or shared.
YouTube is blocked during focus time.
YouTube is blocked until %1$s. Want to learn something instead?
What do you want to learn?
Search YouTube for lessons. Only videos that pass your filters are shown.
No educational videos found for this search. Try different words.
If this channel is a real teacher whose videos are in the wrong category, you can trust it. All its videos will then play (except Shorts).
Creators choose a category when they upload. Only videos in these categories are allowed.
Videos with these words in the title or tags are hidden, even in allowed categories.
None yet. You can trust a channel from a blocked video\'s page.
A key was built into this app. Enter one here only to replace it.
Searching needs a free YouTube Data API v3 key. The README explains how to get one.
